userStories.title: Dataset de coordenadas de municípios brasileiros
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a static coordinate lookup to resolve (city, state) → (lat, lng) for the map without external API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: File `src/modules/organizations/insights/people-map/shared/data/brazilian-city-coordinates.ts` created
Contains a `Map<string, { lat: number; lng: number }>` with ~5570 municipalities (data from Municipios-Brasileiros GitHub repo, MIT license)
Download source JSON from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kelvins/Municipios-Brasileiros/refs/heads/main/json/municipios.json` and convert programmatically
Map key is normalized `cidade-uf` format (no accents, lowercase, hyphens). Ex: `sao-paulo-sp`, `belo-horizonte-mg`
Export helper `normalizeCityStateKey(city: string, state: string): string` — normalizes via NFD, removes diacritics, lowercase, spaces to hyphens, removes special chars
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Service to group members by city and resolve coordinates
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service that transforms the member list into CityPin[] with coordinates, counts, and unmapped members list.
acceptanceCriteria: File `src/modules/organizations/insights/people-map/server/services/list-city-pins-for-map.service.ts` created
Calls the repos from US-003, US-004, and US-005
Groups members by (city, state) using `normalizeCityStateKey` from US-001
Resolves coordinates for each group via the static lookup from US-001
Cities not found in lookup are silently ignored (log warning with `console.warn`)
Builds `CityPin[]` with: `id` = `br-{state lowercase}-{normalized-city}`, `city`, `state`, `country: "Brasil"`, `lat`, `lng`, `users: { id, name }[]`
Brasília (DF) is always the first item (fixed hub), even if it has no members — in that case `users: []`
Returns `OperationResponse<{ pins: CityPin[]; totalMembers: number; mappedMembers: number; unmappedMembers: { id: string; name: string }[] }>`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: City searchable select in edit-address-form
userStories.description: As a user editing my address, I want to pick my city from an official list filtered by my state, ensuring consistent data for the map.
acceptanceCriteria: In `src/modules/accounts/users/ui/edit-address-form.tsx`: city text input replaced with a searchable select (combobox/autocomplete)
